name: HOSE
description: HOSE is a mixed poker format: four games in fixed rotation — Hold'em, Omaha (or Omaha/8), Seven-Card Stud, and Eight or Better (Stud High-Low). Played as limit; shared-card games use blinds, stud games use antes and a bring-in. USA; used in tournaments and mixed games.

content.text: HOSE is a mixed poker format: four games in fixed rotation — Hold'em, Omaha (or Omaha/8), Seven-Card Stud, and Eight or Better (Stud High-Low). Played as limit; shared-card games use blinds, stud games use antes and a bring-in. USA; used in tournaments and mixed games.

Country/Region of Origin: USA
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)
Table space

Cards per player vary by variant: Hold'em 2 hole, Omaha 4 hole, Stud 2 down and 1 up initially then upcards. Dealing clockwise. One complete round of each game (every player deals once) before rotating.

items.text: HORSE (5-game): Five-game rotation: adds Razz to HOSE — Hold'em, Omaha/8, Razz, Seven-Card Stud, Eight or Better.
R.O.E. (3-game): Shorter rotation of three variants (e.g. Razz, Omaha, Eight or Better); cycles faster than HOSE.
